paras: Application: VW Golf Mk8 GTI and Golf R (2020-2024) – models with OEM IQ.Light matrix headlights only Part Type: Fluid Lock CCV oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0887-FL

This Radium kit fits a catch can to collect oil and water condensation from the crankcase gases before they reach the intake. That keeps oil out of the intake, intercooler piping, throttle body and intake manifold and reduces hydrocarbon emissions, while the closed system keeps oil vapour out of the cabin. Everything needed for installation is included.
hl: Fluid Lock Design: Patented mechanism prevents overfilling and traps collected fluid until emptied
Two-Step Baffling: Two-stage oil separation baffling
Integrated Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick for checking the fluid level
Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet, 4AN ORB drain
Direct Fitment: Mounts to OEM holes behind the LH headlight – no drilling, fits under the engine cover
ft: Radium Engineering Catch Can Kit Fluid Lock for VW Golf 2020+
